contract.task:
Export pageAfter(items,cursor,limit) from src/page.mjs. items is an array of objects with unique string id. Preserve input order. cursor=null starts at first item; a known cursor starts immediately after its item; an unknown cursor throws RangeError. limit must be integer 1..100 or throw RangeError. Return {items: page, nextCursor}: nextCursor is last returned id only if more items remain, otherwise null. Do not mutate inputs.
Preserve existing exports and tests. Add at least one executable test in test/. Only src/ and test/ are writable; existing tests are protected.

result.finalText:
Excellent! All tests are now passing. Let me summarize what I've implemented:

1. I implemented the `pageAfter` function in `src/page.mjs` that:
   - Takes an array of items, a cursor, and a limit
   - Validates that the limit is an integer between 1 and 100
   - Finds the starting index based on the cursor (null starts at first item, known cursor starts after that item)
   - Extracts a page of items up to the limit
   - Determines the next cursor as the last returned ID only if more items remain, otherwise null
   - Does not mutate the input items

2. I created a test file `test/pageAfter.test.mjs` that verifies:
   - The function works with a null cursor
   - The function works with a known cursor
   - The function works when the limit reaches the end of the items
   - The function throws a RangeError for invalid limits
   - The function throws a RangeError for unknown cursors

Both the build and test checks are now passing, which means the implementation satisfies all the requirements.
